reason: I had to chase their last report for four months, so B is the one I could recommend. It owns the lateness and names a fix: deadlines on the board calendar, a named volunteer to write each report and a board member to submit it. It also says how results will be measured and gives honest numbers, about 50% more fresh food at harvest and 12% more over the year. A owns the lateness just as plainly but gives no plan to stop it happening again.
